name: @bananaworld/print-kit
description: THE shared label-printing primitives for the Bananaworld estate (CR-DC-227, packhouse API-CHG-005): the ZPL builder (escaping, canvas, text, rule, native QR), the owner-approved legibility floor and type-fitting metrics, and the print-agent WIRE PROTOCOL (the claimed-job shape and the pure validation of what a depot agent sends). Replaces the copy that lived inside the DC. Pure string building: no database, no socket, no process.env. Each app keeps its own spool, label formats and audit hooks. Shipped as TypeScript source; consumers transpile it via Next.js transpilePackages.
